(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & SIL-3 EMERGENCY QUENCH TRIP              *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Active-low fail-safe emergency trip circuit check (toroidal vacuum break / quench trigger) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE;
    iStateStep := 90; (* Jump directly to STATE_EMERGENCY_TRIP_RAPID_ISOLATION_RELIEF *)

(* Operator Diagnostic Reset & Latch Clear Handler *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyTrip THEN

    END_IF;
    IF rT_CryopanelVoted_K < 4.40 THEN
        bTrip_DesorptionAvalanche_Lat := FALSE;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING ENGINE                         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: Divertor Sub-Torr Neutral Gas Pressure 2oo3 Voting                           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC THEN
    (* All 3 channels online: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB) THEN
        IF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB;
        ELSIF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA;
        ELSIF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Inter-channel discrepancy monitoring *)
    IF (ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA - rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar) OR
       (ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB - rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar) OR
       (ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA - rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar) THEN
        rTimer_P_Discrepancy := rTimer_P_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_P_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            (* Isolate faulty channel *)
            IF ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA - rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB - rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_P_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_P_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB) THEN
    rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA + rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA + rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB + rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_P_ChA THEN
        rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChB THEN
        rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChC THEN
        rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC;
    ELSE
        rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := 0.050;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: LHe Cryosorption Panel Temperature 2oo3 Voting                              *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChB AND bHealth_T_ChC THEN
    IF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB) THEN
        IF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB;
        ELSIF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA;
        ELSIF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA - rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB - rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA - rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K) THEN
        rTimer_T_Discrepancy := rTimer_T_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_T_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA - rT_CryopanelVoted_K) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K THEN
                bHealth_T_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB - rT_CryopanelVoted_K) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K THEN
                bHealth_T_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_T_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_T_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChB) THEN
    rT_CryopanelVoted_K := 0.5 * (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA + rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChC) THEN
    rT_CryopanelVoted_K := 0.5 * (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA + rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChB AND bHealth_T_ChC) THEN
    rT_CryopanelVoted_K := 0.5 * (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB + rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_T_ChA THEN
        rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_T_ChB THEN
        rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_T_ChC THEN
        rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC;
    ELSE
        rT_CryopanelVoted_K := 10.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: Superconducting Magnet Coil Current 2oo3 Voting                             *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_I_ChA AND bHealth_I_ChB AND bHealth_I_ChC THEN
    IF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB) THEN
        IF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) THEN
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB;
        ELSIF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) THEN
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC;
        ELSE
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) THEN
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA;
        ELSIF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) THEN
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC;
        ELSE
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA - rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA) OR
       (ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB - rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA) OR
       (ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA - rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA) THEN
        rTimer_I_Discrepancy := rTimer_I_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_I_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA - rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA THEN
                bHealth_I_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB - rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA THEN
                bHealth_I_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_I_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_I_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_I_ChA AND bHealth_I_ChB) THEN
    rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA + rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_I_ChA AND bHealth_I_ChC) THEN
    rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA + rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_I_ChB AND bHealth_I_ChC) THEN
    rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB + rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_I_ChA THEN
        rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_I_ChB THEN
        rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_I_ChC THEN
        rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC;
    ELSE
        rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := 0.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* First-Order Digital Smoothing Filters *)
rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar     := (rFilterWeight * rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar)     + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar);
rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K      := (rFilterWeight * rT_CryopanelVoted_K)      + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K);
rI_Coil_Filt_kA          := (rFilterWeight * rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA)   + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rI_Coil_Filt_kA);
rQ_Throughput_Filt_Pam3s := (rFilterWeight * rQ_NeutralGasThroughput_Pam3s) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rQ_Throughput_Filt_Pam3s);

(* Calculate Magnet Coil Fast Discharge Derivative dI/dt [kA/s] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s := (rI_Coil_Filt_kA - rPreviousI_Coil_kA) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rPreviousI_Coil_kA := rI_Coil_Filt_kA;
END_IF;

(* Fast Quench Event Detection: if dI/dt breaches critical threshold *)
IF (rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s < rQuenchCurrentTripThresh_kA_s) AND (rI_Coil_Filt_kA > 1.0) THEN
    bTrip_QuenchDischarge_Latched := TRUE;
    bQuenchDampingActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: PHYSICAL OBSERVERS & NON-LINEAR CRYOGENIC KINETICS                                *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Mean thermal molecular velocity of Deuterium D2 at cryopanel gas temperature:               *)
(* v_th = SQRT( (8 * R * T) / (pi * M_mol) )                                                    *)
IF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K > 1.0 THEN
    rThermalSpeed_D2_m_s := SQRT((8.0 * rUniversalGasConst_R * rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K) / (3.14159265 * rMolarMass_D2_KgMol));
ELSE
    rThermalSpeed_D2_m_s := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic sticking coefficient degradation as panel approaches desorption threshold (4.8 K) *)
IF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K <= 4.22 THEN
    rStickingCoeff := 0.95;
ELSIF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K < 4.80 THEN
    rStickingCoeff := 0.95 * (1.0 - EXPT(((rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K - 4.22) / 0.58), 2.0));
ELSE
    rStickingCoeff := 0.02; (* Panel blinding / desorptive regime *)
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Volumetric Pumping Speed S_eff [m3/s]:                                             *)
(* S_eff = A_panel * (v_th / 4) * alpha_stick * (Louver_pct / 100)                              *)
rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s := rCryopanelSurfaceArea_M2 * (rThermalSpeed_D2_m_s / 4.0) * rStickingCoeff * (rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct / 100.0);
IF rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s < 0.0 THEN
    rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s := 0.0;
ELSIF rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s > 140.0 THEN
    rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s := 140.0;
END_IF;

(* Hydrogenic Frost Layer Cumulative Mass Integration [mg/cm2] *)
IF (bPumpingActive) AND (rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar > 1.0E-6) THEN
    (* Gas mass flow: dm/dt = Q * (M_mol / (R * T)) *)
    rGasLoadDelta_Mg := (rQ_Throughput_Filt_Pam3s * (rMolarMass_D2_KgMol / (rUniversalGasConst_R * 293.15))) * 1.0E6 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rFrostLayerCoverage_MgCm2 := rFrostLayerCoverage_MgCm2 + (rGasLoadDelta_Mg / (rCryopanelSurfaceArea_M2 * 10000.0));
END_IF;

(* Cryopanel Sorbent Saturation Permissive *)
IF rFrostLayerCoverage_MgCm2 >= rMaxFrostLayerCapacity_MgCm2 THEN
    bRegenerationRequired := TRUE;
ELSE
    bRegenerationRequired := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Temperature Margin to Violent Desorption Avalanche [K] *)
rCryoThermalMargin_K := rDesorptionThreshold_K - rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K;

(* Divertor-to-Core Scrape-Off Layer Neutral Compression Ratio: P_div / P_core *)
IF rForeVacuumPressure_Mbar > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rP_NeutralCompressionRatio := rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar / (rForeVacuumPressure_Mbar * 0.10);
ELSE
    rP_NeutralCompressionRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Magnet Quench Induced Eddy Current Damping Model *)
IF bQuenchDampingActive THEN
    (* Eddy current dynamics: dI_eddy/dt = - (R_shield / L_shield) * I_eddy - M * dI_coil/dt *)
    rQuenchEddyCurrentDamped_kA := (0.65 * ABS(rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s)) * (rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct / 100.0);
ELSE
    rQuenchEddyCurrentDamped_kA := 0.0;
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Format physical plant measurement deviation vector y_meas[4] *)
(* y[1] = delta P_neutral [mbar] (setpoint = 0.0050 mbar) *)
(* y[2] = delta T_cryopanel [K] (nominal = 4.10 K) *)
(* y[3] = delta T_shield [K] (nominal = 52.0 K) *)
(* y[4] = delta I_eddy [kA] (nominal = 0.0 kA) *)
rInnovation[1] := (rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar - 0.0050) - (mC_d[1,1]*xState_Pred[1] + mC_d[1,2]*xState_Pred[2]);
rInnovation[2] := (rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K - 4.10)   - (mC_d[2,2]*xState_Pred[2]);
